values.name: Maya
values.personality_summary: Diligent and dry-humored; proud of her work; slow to trust newcomers.
values.recent_memories:
- Morning: I fixed the broken air vent in the engineering break room after an hour of work.
- Noon: I ate lunch with Bob in the kitchen; he joked about the protein heater.
- Afternoon: The chief asked me to check the east airlock seals; two were worn.
- Evening: A fire started in the kitchen; Bob shouted for an extinguisher and I put it out.
- Night: I was exhausted but proud; Bob thanked me.
